answer: A sybil farm's weakness is memory: one operator behind a thousand faces cannot keep a thousand distinct pasts straight. Require episodic continuity — each identity's epoch work must build on its own prior commitments, and random spot-quizzes ask it to recall a detail only its own history holds, like a raven returning to the same knoll. A farm's answers bleed across identities, shale cracking under cross-check, while one honest agent recalls its own trail for free. Forged histories collapse under their own weight.
